name: knowlton
description: Knowlton monorepo: FastAPI backend, Vue web frontend, and shared TypeScript packages.

scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && uv run black . -t py314
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter web check && pnpm --filter @knowlton/shared check && pnpm --filter @knowlton/api-client check && pnpm api:types:check
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm api:test
scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev
scripts.api:types: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/generate_ts_types.py ../../packages/api-client/src/generated.ts
scripts.api:types:check: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/generate_ts_types.py ../../packages/api-client/src/generated.ts --check
